proseInstruments.sourceLine: Pursuant to the Amended and Restated ABL Credit Agreement, the lenders have extended to CHS a revolving asset-based loan facility in the maximum aggregate principal amount of $ 1.0 billion, subject to borrowing base capacity (the "ABL Facility").

noteRetirements.sourceLine: On February 2, 2026, the Company exercised a special call provision to redeem 10 % of the original principal amount, or approximately $ 223 million, of the 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , at a redemption price of 103 % of the principal amount, plus accrued and unpaid interest.

The Company used approximately $ 600 million of cash on hand from recent divestiture proceeds to repurchase approximately $ 368 million principal amount of its 4.750 % Senior Secured Notes due 2031 , or approximately 35 % of the total outstanding principal amount, and to repurchase approximately $ 231 million principal amount of its 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , or approximately 13 % of the total outstanding principal amount, that were validly tendered and accepted for purchase pursuant to a tender offer that launched on April 22, 2026, and was completed on May 6, 2026, and to pay related fees and expenses.

The Company used approximately $ 600 million of cash on hand from recent divestiture proceeds to repurchase approximately $ 368 million principal amount of its 4.750 % Senior Secured Notes due 2031 , or approximately 35 % of the total outstanding principal amount, and to repurchase approximately $ 231 million principal amount of its 10.875 % Senior Secured Notes due 2032 , or approximately 13 % of the total outstanding principal amount, that were validly tendered and accepted for purchase pursuant to a tender offer that launched on April 22, 2026, and was completed on May 6, 2026, and to pay related fees and expenses.

results.evidence: No new debt issuance in the current period. The 10-Q for September 30, 2026 shows no new debt issuances; all debt activity consists of redemptions and repurchases of existing notes.
No acquisitions announced or completed in the current period. The company has completed divestitures of hospitals and facilities but has not announced any acquisitions of other businesses.

results.triggerName: Capex program / new facility or construction
results.evidence: Capital expenditures totaled $239 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, with expected total capital expenditures of approximately $350 million to $400 million in 2026. Capex relates primarily to expansion and renovation of existing facilities, construction of additional access points such as free-standing emergency departments and ambulatory surgery centers, investments in higher acuity service lines and information technology infrastructure.
results.verifiedQuote: Capital expenditures totaled $239 million and $241 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. We expect total capital expenditures of approximately $350 million to $400 million in 2026.
results.verifiedQuoteNormalized: Capital expenditures totaled $239 million and $241 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively. We expect total capital expenditures of approximately $350 million to $400 million in 2026.

results.evidence: The ABL Facility has $745 million of available borrowing capacity out of $1.0 billion total capacity as of September 30, 2026, with no outstanding borrowings. The facility is not near capacity.
No dividend or share buyback authorization announced in the current period. The company has repurchased debt but not equity.
Cash and cash equivalents were $155 million at September 30, 2026, down from $260 million at December 31, 2025. This represents a decline in cash balance, not a large or growing balance.
results.mappedNeed: Liquidity management, earning on idle cash

results.evidence: The company completed the sale of Crestwood Medical Center in Huntsville, Alabama to Huntsville Hospital Health System for $459 million in cash on April 1, 2026. Additionally, the company completed the sale of four hospitals in Arkansas (Northwest Medical Center - Bentonville, Northwest Medical Center - Springdale, Northwest Medical Center - Willow Creek Women's Hospital, and Siloam Springs Regional Hospital) to Freeman Health System for $110 million in cash on June 1, 2026.
results.verifiedQuote: The purchase price paid to CHS in connection with the closing of the Transaction, after giving effect to estimated working capital and before certain transaction expenses, was $459 million in cash (subject to a post-closing working capital adjustment).
results.verifiedQuoteNormalized: The purchase price paid to CHS in connection with the closing of the Transaction, after giving effect to estimated working capital and before certain transaction expenses, was $459 million in cash (subject to a post-closing working capital adjustment).

results.evidence: No international expansion or foreign revenue growth disclosed. The company operates exclusively in the United States across 14 states.
